column1: # The draw-param fields Sekiro registers (1.06), one per line: key, GPARAM type code, subtype,
# interpolate flag (`-`: no Sekiro slot reads it).
# Read from the executable: each call of the field registrar (the descriptor it builds: type and subtype; the
# byte argument it stores as the field's interpolate flag) and each call of the enum-field templates (type 3,
# subtype 22, interpolate 0). Every key the installed files store at several hours is here or is a name the
# executable does not contain: a field the game never reads. A character outside ASCII is written \u{hex}.
